value.title: La rivolta molesta dei prigionieri
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri go to a facility located on a violent windstormed planet in an attempt to rescue a hardened warden from a bunch of prisoners who have overtaken the facility.

value.title: La festa di Halloween definitiva
value.synopsis: The city celebrates Halloween with a large-scale cosplay, but the two girls can't celebrate as the 3WA has assigned them to capture a runaway android that resembles The Terminator. They must do so within the hour or something bad will happen. Meanwhile, some of the local criminals organize some heists

value.title: La sfida di Dio
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri go undercover on a world that is run by a planet-wide religion to investigate a corporate town site that was been devastated by a supposedly divine being. Yuri discovers the secret to how the deity is able to demonstrate his divine powers while Kei gets upset that the god keeps killing off her potential boyfriends.

value.title: Giochi di guerra uguale squadra che spara!
value.synopsis: A military base has been taken over by a group of kids. Kei and Yuri are assigned the task of stopping the kids but without harming them as they are the sons and daughters of various high-ranking officials and leaders. The kids think this is all fun and games as they fight off the girls, but when they accidentally activate a super-powerful weapon, the military decides to authorize the use of deadly force. It will be up to Kei and Yuri to save the day.

value.title: E poi nessuno ha scherzato
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri go to a space casino facility to recover one of the top 3WA agents who has fallen into a deep gambling habit. They find the guy at a high-stakes game called Meteor, which involves shooting meteor rocks around a planet and placing bets as to where it will land. Kei dresses up as a participant while Yuri searches the facility for clues as to how the game is rigged.

value.title: Panico da matrimonio a sorpresa sulla spiaggia
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri visit an island whose prosperity is built mainly upon a family's counterfeiting operation. Yuri poses as an archeology student but is befriended by a handsome guy, while Kei gets to apply her skills in another not so romantic job. Yuri almost gets into trouble when she is caught snooping around on the church grounds, but the guy bails her out, and they fall in love, and suddenly they're getting married! The 3WA gang is flown in for the wedding, but Kei is still suspicious, and so are the family's members.

value.title: La rivincita della ragazza muscolosa
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri go into the underworld of cage fighting to track down a former 3WA trainee named Sandra who is linked to a performance enhancing drug called Hustle (Hard Muscle) that's been sweeping the sport.

value.title: La bella addormentata
value.synopsis: Some terrorists attack a space station. A man puts his daughter into a capsule to escape. Kei and Yuri find her escape pod but she hasn't aged a bit in twenty years because the capsule is a cold sleep one. As the only witness to the incident, the girl is put under the supervision of Kei and Yuri as they try to unravel her past and what she remembers from the incident. But not everyone is keen on having secrets revealed.

value.title: Fermate la squadra dei macellai!
value.synopsis: A longtime war is nearing its end when a squad of five red eyed soldiers disrupts the peace process, destroying everyone. Kei and Yuri go to a town to investigate, and after convincing the locals they aren't government officials, they manage to get a ride to the site where they find one of the five soldiers is injured, and learn the secret behind who's behind the operation.

value.title: Noi siamo camioniste spaziali!
value.synopsis: The space trucks from an independent shipping company have been attacked recently, and with the Universal Corporation taking over operations, many of the truckers are dejected. Kei and Yuri go undercover and join the trucking staff for the shipping company and travel with two truckers who are still willing to face adversity.

value.title: Project Eden
value.synopsis: After stopping a group of Vizorium smugglers, Kei and Yuri, the Lovely Angels (more commonly known as the Dirty Pair), are sent on a mission to Agerna, a planet rich with Vizorium, a mineral necessary for space travel. They are sent to stop the mysterious attacks on mining operations that have the governments of the world pointing fingers and blaming each other. While the pair bathe, Carson D. Carson, a former member of the group of smugglers they stopped on their last mission, interrupts their baths by falling through a vent. While Kei and Yuri get out of the bathtubs and question Carson, they are attacked by strange alien monsters that force the Angels to flee, leaving their equipment behind and wearing nothing but towels.
